name: 🐱Ay Mi Gatito Tower 🎵
desc:
😺🎶 Welcome to the Ay Mi Gatito Tower! 🎶😺

💀 Can you survive the chaotic climb… or will the mischievous Gatito knock you into the abyss?
😼 Maybe you’ll become the ultimate troublemaker and send others flying off the tower!

🎁 Join our group for an exclusive Ay Mi Gatito Slap
👉 Troll Tower Studios! – https://www.roblox.com/communities/322619664

💚 Thanks for playing — and keep an eye out for the Gatito… you really don’t want to miss him.

Inspired by Slap Tower and other chaotic slap games.

scripts.script:
--[[ To disable, Run the script again. Altough it takes like 30 seconds to fully stop lol
Will NOT work on Delta and Volcano because it fakes products. Tested on Bunni.]]
local s,p = game:GetService("MarketplaceService"), game.Players.LocalPlayer
local f = function(...) s:SignalPromptProductPurchaseFinished(...) end
_G.chaos = not _G.chaos
if not _G.chaos then return end
task.spawn(function()
    while _G.chaos do
        f(p.UserId,3501169395,true)
        f(p.UserId,3501171773,true)
        f(p.UserId,3501185614,true)
        f(p.UserId,3501188462,true)
        f(p.UserId,3501192310,true)
        task.wait(0.01) -- increase this to cause less chaos and make it easier to stop
    end
end)
